messages:
alice: FYI customer 'OptiCorp' on private deployment reports invoice tokens ~= 1.35M but their dashboard shows 1.18M. Flagging for triage, they say this started after last week's agent upgrade.
ben: Ack. Which agent version and OS? any recent restarts?
alice: Agent v2.4.1, onprem VM image ubuntu-20.04. They applied the 2.4.1 agent on Mar 2 and rolled back to 2.3.9 yesterday. No full reboots, only service restarts.
carmen: Do we have meter-agent logs from that window? request the onprem support bundle ( /var/log/redwood/meter-agent.log* and /var/lib/redwood/meter/queue )
dmitri: Poking their support bundle now. Quick grep shows a bunch of "kvs.cache miss, buffering to disk" lines and repeated "event_publish: EPIPE" around 2025-03-02T18:12:xxZ.
alice: Customer says for one API key the dashboard token count is stable but billing line items (invoice) show extra ~170k tokens attributed to the same key. They double-checked that no other teams used the key.
ingrid: Possible causes: clock skew leading to duplicate replay, seq id wrap, or a replay loop during offline buffering. Did we observe any replay on our ingestion edge?
meter-bot: alert: meter-replay-detector detected 3 potential replay windows for customer OptiCorp between 2025-03-02T18:10:00Z and 2025-03-02T18:20:00Z. Correlation score: 0.72
dmitri: Cross-referenced agent logs with our ingestion trace. The agent published a batch with start_seq 987654 and end_seq 988400, then shortly after published an overlapping batch 987900-988800. Looks like partial re-send of a window (overlap ~500 events).
ben: Overlap could be due to agent local buffer not acknowledging publish success and retrying. Are acks missing on our side? Check the collector logs for 2025-03-02T18:12.
carmen: Collector logs show transient 502 from edge to meter-ingest for ~30s at 18:11:58Z. The agent marks batch as sent only on TCP write, but our ingest can close connection before final ack, agent doesn't get final application-layer ack, so it retries the batch.
sam-billing: From billing perspective we dedupe by event id when possible, but invoices are generated off the ledger after ingestion and dedupe window is 1 minute. If duplicates cross that window (or have distinct event ids due to clock/seq munging) billing can count both.
alice: The customer is on a slightly older agent config: they had sequence persistence disabled (persist_seq = false) to reduce disk I/O historically. That could cause seq id reuse after restarts. They did service restarts during the outage.
dmitri: That explains some duplicates. Also saw logs: "localclock jump: +1800s" followed by sequence reset in the agent at 18:14:02Z. So clockjump + restart + transient 502 => overlap + replay.
ingrid: Action plan proposal: 1) Recommend agent config change persist_seq=true and enable at-least-once suppression (client-side dedupe) 2) Patch agent to only mark batch delivered after explicit ingest acknowledgment 3) Backfill dedupe on the ingest side for that customer for the affected window 4) Coordinate invoice adjustment if ledger shows double-counted tokens.
ben: For the short term we can run a dedupe pass for OptiCorp between 2025-03-02T18:00:00Z and 2025-03-02T19:00:00Z. I can produce a script to collapse overlapping seq windows and subtract token counts (needs billing sign-off).
sam-billing: Please put numbers in a PRD. If we can justify a customer credit (and verify ledger change), billing will issue a credit for the amount.
carmen: Repro steps for internal QA: spin up agent v2.4.1 with persist_seq=false, simulate 502 on ingest for ~30s, restart agent service mid-buffer, advance clock +30 minutes. Observe overlapping publish and duplicate ledger entries. I'll create a minimal repro and paste logs.
alice: Customer notified and asked for ETA. They're anxious because it's affecting their monthly reconciliation.
ben: ETA: I'll have dedupe run + a list of affected token ids in ~4 hours. Patch timeline: agent change (mark-delivered-after-ack) will be an engineering change — target in next minor release unless backported.
dmitri: Note: we should add a metric for agent unacked-retries and a collector-side idempotency id check. Filed infra ticket INF-4123.
ingrid: Also remind customers to enable persist_seq when using onprem/offline buffering. Add to docs and onboarding checks.
alice: Thanks team. I'll update OptiCorp with proposed credit workflow and ETA.
meter-bot: info: support-ticket #15982 updated -> dedupe job scheduled.
